entities.name: Louis Alexandre, Count of Toulouse
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Alexandre de Bourbon, a legitimated prince of the blood royal, was the son of Louis XIV and of his mistress Françoise-Athénaïs, marquise de Montespan. At the age of five, he became grand admiral of France.
